dew.definition: n. water that has condensed on a cool surface overnight from water vapor in the air
dew.translation:
n. 露珠, 露水
vt. (用露水)沾湿
vi. 结露水

dew cure.translation: [医] 践露疗法, 克奈普氏法

dew's method.translation: [医] 迪尤氏法(新生儿窒息急救法)

dew's sign.translation: [医] 迪尤氏征(见于膈下棘球蚴囊脓肿)

dew-claws.translation: (dew-claw 的复数) n. （动物的）残留趾

dewalee.translation: n. 排灯节(印度的重大宗教节日之一,每年在10 月或11月举行)

dewan.translation: n. (印度的)政府高级官员, (尤指)邦政府的首席部长

dewar.definition: n. Scottish chemist and physicist noted for his work in cryogenics and his invention of the Dewar flask (1842-1923)

dewar flask.translation: [医] 迪尤尔氏瓶, 真空瓶

dewar(vacuum)flask.translation: [化] 真空瓶; 杜瓦(真空)瓶

dewatered sludge.translation: [医] 干污泥, 除水污泥

dewatering.translation: [化] 脱水的; 脱水; 脱水作用

dewaters.translation: v. 脱[去]水的( dewatered的现在分词 )

dewaxed.translation: (dewax 的过去分词) vt. 使脱蜡

dewberries.definition:
plural of dewberry
n. any of several trailing blackberry brambles especially of North America
n. blackberry-like fruits of any of several trailing blackberry bushes
dewberries.translation: (dewberry 的复数) n. 悬钩子属植物, 露莓

dewberry.definition:
n. any of several trailing blackberry brambles especially of North America
n. blackberry-like fruits of any of several trailing blackberry bushes
dewberry.translation: n. 悬钩子属植物, 露莓

dewbow.translation: n. 露虹(在结露的表面上形成的虹)

dewclaw.definition:
n. In any animal, esp. of the Herbivora, a rudimentary claw
   or small hoof not reaching the ground.

dewclaws.definition:
plural of dewclaw
n. In any animal, esp. of the Herbivora, a rudimentary claw
   or small hoof not reaching the ground.
dewclaws.translation: (dewclaw 的复数) n. 残留趾, 假蹄

dewdrops.definition:
plural of dewdrop
n. a drop of dew

dewed.translation: vt. 弄湿（dew的过去式与过去分词形式）

dewees' carminative.translation: [医] 迪威斯氏驱风剂(含氧化镁、阿魏及鸦片)

dewees' sign.translation: [医] 迪威斯氏征(孕妇吐白色粘痰)

dewey.definition:
n. United States librarian who founded the decimal system of classification (1851-1931)
n. a United States naval officer remembered for his victory at Manila Bay in the Spanish-American War
n. United States pragmatic philosopher who advocated progressive education (1859-1952)

deweyan.definition: a. of or relating to John Dewey or his philosophy
deweyan.translation: a. (美国哲学家)J.杜威的,杜威哲学的

deweyism.translation: n. [哲]杜威主义,(哲学、教育学中的)实用主义

deweyite.translation: n. (美国哲学家)J.杜威的门徒,杜威哲学思想研究者

dewfall.definition: n. The falling of dew; the time when dew begins to fall.
dewfall.translation: n. 降露, 降露之时

dewi.translation: n. (Dewi)人名；(英)戴维, 黛维(女名)；(印尼)黛维

dewier.translation: a. 带露水的, 露湿的；如露的 (dewy的变形)

dewiest.translation: a. dewy（带露水的, 露湿的）的变形

dewily.translation: adv. 露水般地, 清新地, 纯洁地

dewing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Dew

dewlap.definition: n. a hanging fold of loose skin on an elderly person's neck

dewlaps.definition: n. a hanging fold of loose skin on an elderly person's neck
dewlaps.translation: n. 垂肉；胖人喉部鼓出的肥肉；垂皮

dewret.definition: v. t. To ret or rot by the process called dewretting.
dewret.translation: vt.用露水浸渍(麻),用露水沤(麻)

dewretting.definition:
n. Dewrotting; the process of decomposing the gummy matter
   of flax and hemp and setting the fibrous part, by exposure on a sward
   to dew, rain, and sunshine.

dewrot.definition:
v. t. To rot, as flax or hemp, by exposure to rain, dew, and
   sun. See Dewretting.

dews.definition: n water that has condensed on a cool surface overnight from water vapor in the air

dewy.translation: a. 露湿的, 带露水的, 如露的

dewy-eyed.definition: s exhibiting childlike simplicity and credulity
dewy-eyed.translation: a. 天真的, 容易相信的
